source_behavior.trigger: one-shot triggered/armed flags; HUD release rearms and queues a new shot
source_behavior.marker: FindObjectOfType(UIMapContentController, true); reflected real-position fields, fallback mark-controller.m_pos
source_behavior.map_y: Uses marker Y in target-minus-origin; no terrain raycast in this block
source_behavior.gravity: default50; abs(reflected get_FallingGravity()) accepted if5..160, otherwise default retained
source_behavior.xz: D/time*xz_factor; not limited to100 in this block
source_behavior.direction: normalized horizontal target-origin, local forward if horizontal distance<=0.001
source_behavior.stop: No destination feedback or explicit stop in inspected block; not proof of server landing behavior
source_behavior.no_marker: Falls back to camera/local forward, time1/XZ25/Y20

not_proven: benefit of using reflection rather than exact calls
